summary: Deep rewrite of Chapter 19 — The Stack: Deferred Multi-Intent Execution. Explains the fundamental problem of sequential dependency in multi-intent messages, why parallel execution is impossible, the first-intent execute pattern, the Redis-persisted stack structure, resumeIntentStack and how it advances the queue, the ordinal re-resolution problem and its solution, stack-scoped vs global search context, the UUID guard for stale partial resolutions, stack-microstate coordination, and TTL management.
